en.seoTitle: The team & your contacts | Nordic RentAway Spain
en.seoDescription: Meet your contacts at Nordic RentAway Spain. Speak to Johan Sjölin about your Costa Blanca property, or reach the guest experience team.
en.heading:
Your home is here.
So is the team.
en.intro: Nordic RentAway Spain works with rental homes, property management and related services in Alicante province.
en.body: Our international team handles the work around holiday homes and their guests. Property care, interiors and advice can be discussed alongside rental management.
en.contactsText: For a first conversation about your property, get in touch with Johan or Isabel.
en.localText: The team also shares a local guide to places, food and activities on the Costa Blanca through We Recommend.
